The  '''Austrian Statistical Society ''' (Österreichischen Statistischen Gesellschaft) is a national scientific organization. It publishes  the ''Austrian Journal of Statistics'' ({{OCLC|609923675}}), formerly known as the ''Österreichische Zeitschrift für Statistik'' ({{OCLC|44588411}}).

==Journal==
The official journal of the society is the ''Austrian Journal of Statistics'' ({{ISSN|1026-597X}}), a quarterly [[peer-reviewed]] [[open access]] [[scientific journal]] published under a [[Creative Commons Attribution License]] (CC-BY).<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.osg.or.at/main.asp?VID=1&kat1=97&kat2=642 |title=Austrian Journal of Statistics /|publisher=Gesellschaft Oesterreichische Statistische |website=Homepage |access-date=2016-03-07}}</ref> It was established in 1972 and covers the use of [[Statistics|statistical methods]] in all kind of theoretical and applied disciplines. Special emphasis is put on methods and results in [[official statistics]].

===Editors===
The following persons have been [[editors-in-chief]] of the journal:
*2014–2016 Matthias Templ
*2004–2013 Herwig Friedl
*2002–2012 Rudolf Dutter
